gaps.lead: He spoke slowly so that the interpreter could follow.
I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: Visitors may not feed the animals.
His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.lead: She hates it when people interrupt her.
The tickets are certain to be expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: be bound to do = be certain to do.
